name.en: High Plank Alternating Side Toe Tap

purpose.zh: 练核心，在支撑变化时稳住骨盆
purpose.en: Build your core to keep the pelvis steady as your base changes.

text.zh: 高位平板，一只脚向侧点地再收回
text.en: In a high plank, tap one foot out to the side and back

text.zh: 骨盆始终朝向地面，不左右晃
text.en: Keep your pelvis facing the floor without swaying.
Keep your hands planted and switch feet.

commonErrors.en: Rotating the pelvis to one side.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
